_doc: The surf_src_sidistic walls in map order, for autoresearch/ladder.py and the 2x stop rule (PROTOCOL.md), measured against RUN 5 of the unified-recipe program (unr1b3_mcts5, 2026-11-08/09: PPO beside an MCTS search whose lines feed a backward curriculum, one recipe from scratch, RTX 5080; it finished the map at 8.23B steps and is this program's incumbent recipe). TWO units. run5_step = the trainer's step counter (simulator ticks spent in PPO rollouts: 1024 envs x 10 ms ticks) at which run 5's GREEDY eval from the true start first got past the wall; deadline_step = 2 x that. run5_total = run5_step + run5_search_ticks, the simulator ticks of every search that had started by then (autoresearch/search_ticks.py: search_wall_s x env_steps_per_s per search); deadline_total = 2 x that. The user's rule, 2026-11-08: 'if the algorithm doesn't beat the wall in twice time it was beaten before, then the algorithm doesn't work.' The two early walls carry a floor (1.6B steps, 2.0B total ticks) instead of 2x, because the first ramp alone varied 0.18-1.51B between from-scratch runs of one recipe. october_step is the earlier reference (the October lineage, a recipe changed at nearly every wall), kept for the record only. One seed: run 5 is ONE run, so a wall cleared somewhat later than run 5 is not evidence against a recipe; a missed 2x deadline is.
